name: promptshield-vscode
description: AI Firewall for VS Code / Antigravity: scan prompts, code selections, and files for sensitive data before you send them to an AI chat, enforced by the PromptShield backend policy engine.

chatParticipants.name: promptshield
chatParticipants.description: Scan a prompt against your organization's PromptShield policies before you send it elsewhere.

commands.title: PromptShield: Scan & Copy Approved Text to Clipboard

promptshield.backendUrl.description: Base URL of the PromptShield backend (same backend used by the browser extension and CLI).

promptshield.organizationId.description: Optional organization identifier sent with requests for multi-tenant deployments.

promptshield.enableWorkspaceScan.description: Automatically scan files as they are opened/saved in the workspace and surface findings in the Problems panel.

promptshield.enableFileScan.description: Allow scanning of attached/selected files (via commands or chat participant) for sensitive content.

promptshield.enablePromptScan.description: Enable prompt scanning via the @promptshield chat participant and scan commands.

promptshield.enableConversationContext.description: Include prior chat participant turns (conversation history) as context when scanning a prompt.

promptshield.maxFileSizeKb.description: Maximum file size (KB) that will be read and scanned. Larger files are skipped with a warning.

promptshield.autoRedaction.description: When the backend decision is REDACT, automatically use the sanitized text instead of prompting the user each time.

promptshield.strictMode.description: When enabled, WARN decisions cannot be bypassed by the user - only ALLOW/REDACT results may proceed.

promptshield.telemetry.description: Persist raw prompt text in local scan history (globalState) for your own reference. Off by default - only metadata (decision, risk, timestamp, site) is stored otherwise.

promptshield.debugMode.description: Verbose logging in the PromptShield Output Channel (still sanitized - secrets/PII are redacted before being logged).

promptshield.failureMode.description: What to do when the backend is unreachable: 'open' allows the action through with a warning banner, 'closed' blocks it.
